items.title: BSX Q2 Deep Dive: WATCHMAN and Electrophysiology Challenges Temper Growth Outlook
items.summary: Medical device company Boston Scientific (NYSE:BSX) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 7.5% year on year to $5.44 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $5.27 billion was less impressive, coming in 2.2% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.86 per share was 3.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
